about: Casting for the player voice sets' pre-rendered barks. Each set has two casts, so a player can pick a lower or a higher voice for the same personality. Presets are Gemini TTS / Chirp3-HD voice names, the same ones the server's live TTS uses (en-US-Chirp3-HD-<preset>), so a line with no clip can be spoken live in the same voice.
